subject: Animation
title: Strange World and the Box Office Question
description: A quick win: understand Strange World and the Box Office Question.

hook.text: Strange World in 2022 lost Disney over $100 million, raising questions about the future of theatrical animation.

buildup.text: Audiences increasingly chose streaming over theaters for animated films after the pandemic changed viewing habits.

discovery.text: Disney had trained families to wait for Disney Plus releases, accidentally undermining their own theatrical business.

twist.text: Meanwhile, Spider-Verse and Mario proved audiences will still pack theaters for the right animated event.

climax.text: The struggle between streaming and theaters is reshaping how Disney plans every animated film's release.

punchline.text: Disney accidentally taught audiences to skip theaters for streaming.

quiz.question: What challenge did Strange World's failure highlight for Disney animation?
options: Audiences no longer enjoy animated films
Post-pandemic viewing habits and Disney Plus trained families to skip theaters for streaming
The film was too expensive to produce
